title: Crown Hill Winery
specs: Located in Texas Hill Country with outdoor patio and serene views
Children must be supervised by parents at all times
Groups larger than 8 must contact winery to ensure accommodation
includes: Guided tasting with tasting notes and information about varietals
blurb: Guests enjoy guided tastings of a portfolio of Texas wines with tasting notes and varietal information. Tastings take approximately 45 minutes. After tasting, guests can relax on the outdoor patio and purchase wine by the glass or bottle to enjoy on site.
extraNote: Reservations can be cancelled at any time; cards charged at check-in · Pets allowed outside on patio and lawn if leashed; owners must pick up droppings · Smoking/vaping prohibited on premises
